Name: SVE Trees of Simple Foliage for Vibrant Pastoral Redrawn(VPR) and Earthy Recolour
Author: 1oOwOo1
Description:
简单树叶风格的SVE树木，与[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6367]充满活力的田园着色[/url]和[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5255]大地色[/url]适配。
感谢 [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/37803135]Hitme[/url] 的授权，以及出色的[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/35354]模组[/url]。
安装方法：下载解压后直接放到Mods文件夹里。

SVE Trees in Simple Foliage-esque style, compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6367]Vibrant Pastoral Redrawn(VPR)[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5255]DaisyNiko's Earthy Recolour[/url].
Thanks for [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/37803135]Hitme[/url]'s permission, and incredible [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/35354]mod[/url].
How to install: Download and extract this file into your mods folder.
